short: the UIs: thin composition roots over the command engine
is: The three binaries that drive the core: each picks its adapters, builds a Session for its edition and runs commands through `application::commands::dispatch`.
conventions: An app is a composition root: the only place an adapter is chosen.
An app reaches the core through `Session` and `commands::dispatch`, never a port directly.

fs.name: cli/
fs.role: command-line UI: a Full session over adapter-mem's demo account, one `<id> [json]` command per stdin line

fs.name: mini/
fs.role: Unofficial Mini Telegram, the Limited UI for wasm32: a stub until its toolkit is chosen

fs.name: rusty/
fs.role: Unofficial Rusty Telegram, the Full desktop UI: a beta stub

notes: mini is linted for wasm32-unknown-unknown with domain and application (`just wasm`), so the core stays browser-safe.
